note: Conceptual/architecture lesson on four recurring data-modeling patterns (junction, hierarchy, polymorphic lookup, event-log). No screenshots per this course's policy: taught through prose, tables, and a written scenario, never UI click-paths. The Task.WhoId polymorphic-field claim was verified directly against Salesforce's official object reference page, which states WhoId represents a lead or contact and that WhoIds are polymorphic. The absence of a true custom polymorphic lookup field type is described generally rather than with an invented limit number.
